propositions: A capability scheduled only via GitHub Actions with no operation-linked or in-process fallback breaks for adopters using alternate CI providers or no CI at all.

The project.portability criterion's Platform and venue matrix cell treats CI as an undifferentiated venue, leaving alternate shapes (different CI provider, no CI provider) unnameable and undetectable by the rubric.

The criterion's detection text must explicitly name both 'CI under any provider' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all' and specify that sole-trigger CI-system dependencies require a fallback or draw a finding.

The rubric authority (.rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-portability.md), its hand-authored mirror (docs/plan-review-gate.md), and test pinning (test_project_portability_criterion.py, test_project_portability_docs.py) must all carry the updated matrix cell and no-CI-provider rule in sync.
